from primitive_api import *

plate_id = "Plate|-01.26|+00.91|-03.80"
sink_basin_id = "Sink|-01.79|+00.90|-03.75|SinkBasin"
faucet_id = "Faucet|-01.79|+01.14|-03.91"
counter_id = "CounterTop|-01.79|+00.95|-03.80"

# 1. Put the plate in the sink
r1 = put_object(plate_id, sink_basin_id)
print("Put in sink:", r1["valid_action"], r1["error"], r1["verification"])

# 2. Turn the water on and then off
r2 = toggle_object(faucet_id, on=True)
print("Faucet on:", r2["valid_action"], r2["error"], r2["verification"])

r3 = toggle_object(faucet_id, on=False)
print("Faucet off:", r3["valid_action"], r3["error"], r3["verification"])

# Check plate state
print("Plate state after wash:", query_object_state(plate_id))

# 3. Pick the plate up again
r4 = pickup_object(plate_id)
print("Pickup clean plate:", r4["valid_action"], r4["error"], r4["verification"])

# 4. Place on CounterTop|-01.79|+00.95|-03.80
# First try directly if CounterTop is visible, or move left/right as needed
r5 = put_object(plate_id, counter_id)
print("Put on counter from sink:", r5["valid_action"], r5["error"], r5["verification"])

if not check_success()["success"]:
    # Move to the left (towards x=-1.25) and stand next to the counter
    rotate("left")
    move_ahead()
    move_ahead()
    rotate("right")
    obs_c = inspect_current_view(label="at_counter", remember=True)
    print(
        "Visible at counter:",
        [
            (o.get("objectId"), o.get("objectType"))
            for o in obs_c["visible_objects"]
        ],
    )
    r6 = put_object(plate_id, counter_id)
    print(
        "Put on counter after moving:",
        r6["valid_action"],
        r6["error"],
        r6["verification"],
    )

print("Final check_success:", check_success())
print("Final check_progress:", check_progress_public())

    ],
)

# Try putting plate in sink basin now

from primitive_api import *

plate_id = "Plate|-01.26|+00.91|-03.80"
counter_id = "CounterTop|-01.79|+00.95|-03.80"

# Look down so the CounterTop surface is visible past the held plate
look("down")
obs_d = observe()
print(
    "Visible looking down:",
    [
        (o.get("objectId"), o.get("objectType"))
        for o in obs_d["visible_objects"]
    ],
)

r1 = put_object(plate_id, counter_id)
print(
    "Put on counter (looking down):",
    r1["valid_action"],
    r1["error"],
    r1["verification"],
)

if not check_success()["success"]:
    look("up")
    # Move back to (-1.75, -3.25) where Put on CounterTop succeeded in Turn 4!
    rotate("right")
    move_ahead()
    move_ahead()
    rotate("left")
    obs_s = observe()
    print(
        "Visible at (-1.75, -3.25):",
        [
            (o.get("objectId"), o.get("objectType"))
            for o in obs_s["visible_objects"]
        ],
    )
    r2 = put_object(plate_id, counter_id)
    print(
        "Put on counter at (-1.75, -3.25):",
        r2["valid_action"],
        r2["error"],
        r2["verification"],
    )

if not check_success()["success"]:
    # Use place_held_object wrapper as fallback
    r3 = place_held_object("CounterTop", obj=plate_id)
    print("place_held_object:", r3["ok"], r3["progress"])

inspect_current_view(label="completed", remember=True)
print("Final check_success:", check_success())
print("Final check_progress:", check_progress_public())
